I have implemented full observable query state restoration and reconciliation for fine-grained persisted queries across `@tanstack/query-core`, `@tanstack/query-persist-client-core`, and framework adapters on branch `fix/persister-restore-state`:

- **Persister Restore Marker (`@tanstack/query-core`)**:
  - Added and exported [`createPersisterRestoreResult`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-meirr2u8/packages/query-core/src/query.ts#L168-L180), [`isPersisterRestoreResult`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-meirr2u8/packages/query-core/src/query.ts#L182-L192), and [`normalizeRestoredQueryState`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-meirr2u8/packages/query-core/src/query.ts#L194-L263) in [query.ts](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-meirr2u8/packages/query-core/src/query.ts) and [index.ts](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-meirr2u8/packages/query-core/src/index.ts), and updated [`QueryPersister`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-meirr2u8/packages/query-core/src/types.ts#L131-L143) in [types.ts](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-meirr2u8/packages/query-core/src/types.ts).
  - Updated [`Query.fetch`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-meirr2u8/packages/query-core/src/query.ts#L684-L693) to adopt restored `PersisterRestoreResult` snapshots via [`Query.restoreState`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-meirr2u8/packages/query-core/src/query.ts#L387-L395) (`fetchStatus: 'idle'`, preserving `status`, `error`, `isRefetchError`, counters, timestamps, invalidation markers, and infinite-query `pages`/`pageParams`) without invoking `setData` or triggering `onSuccess`/`onSettled` callbacks.
  - Updated [`QueryObserver`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-meirr2u8/packages/query-core/src/queryObserver.ts#L450-L456) ([`shouldFetchOnMount`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-meirr2u8/packages/query-core/src/queryObserver.ts#L761-L776) and [`shouldFetchOptionally`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-meirr2u8/packages/query-core/src/queryObserver.ts#L796-L811)) so observers mounting on restored queries retain persisted failure counts, timestamps, and error metadata instead of resetting them with fresh fetch state.
- **Fine-Grained Persister & Bulk Reconciliation (`@tanstack/query-persist-client-core`)**:
  - Updated [`experimental_createQueryPersister`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-meirr2u8/packages/query-persist-client-core/src/createPersister.ts#L186-L527) in [createPersister.ts](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-meirr2u8/packages/query-persist-client-core/src/createPersister.ts) so `persisterFn` returns `createPersisterRestoreResult({ data, state })` and `restoreQueries` restores full normalized `QueryState` snapshots and reconciles existing in-memory queries via [`reconcileRestoredQueryState`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-meirr2u8/packages/query-persist-client-core/src/createPersister.ts#L84-L165) by merging data freshness (`dataUpdatedAt`) and error freshness (`errorUpdatedAt`) independently.
- **Adapter Support & Tests**:
  - Updated [useBaseQuery.ts](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-meirr2u8/packages/vue-query/src/useBaseQuery.ts#L139-L157) and [useQueries.ts](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-meirr2u8/packages/vue-query/src/useQueries.ts#L324-L344) in `@tanstack/vue-query` to subscribe when `client.isRestoring` is undefined.
  - Added tests in [query.test.tsx](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-meirr2u8/packages/query-core/src/__tests__/query.test.tsx#L1380-L1517), [createPersister.test.ts](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-meirr2u8/packages/query-persist-client-core/src/__tests__/createPersister.test.ts#L684-L896), and [fine-grained-persister.test.tsx](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-meirr2u8/packages/react-query/src/__tests__/fine-grained-persister.test.tsx#L186-L320).
